notes: Card: peaks on digits inside ISSNs and DOI/BMC journal codes in reference lists ('ISSN 0271-2⟦0⟧91', 'j.1741-3⟦7⟧29', '1471-2⟦4⟧58'), plus a space before a percentage in a list. Probe failed: short prose sentences with an ISSN, a DOI, a phone number, 4-4-2 or a part number all scored <=0.12. Best guess: the pole needs the full eprint-style reference context, so fire items copy that format with repeated ISSNs and Wiley/BMC URLs. Near misses keep the reference entries but spell out the numbers. Expected to fail.
